headline: Thursday Pressers
deck: Daniel James a doubt for Leeds United with a back problem
body: Daniel James is a doubt for Leeds United with a back problem, according to Daniel Farke. No timescale came with it, so he is neither ruled in nor ruled out.

teamNews.line: Harry Wilson has returned to team training after a muscle injury, though he stays on the absentee list for now.

quote.text: Some good news with Harry Wilson after his muscle injury. He’s back in team training since Tuesday.

teamNews.line: The international break produced one new casualty, Ewen, and the rest of the travellers came back unscathed.

quote.text: Ewen was a difficult one, with a hamstring. He will be out for a couple of months, but the rest should be okay.

teamNews.line: Alex Scott is the one man not back on the pitch, with a further scan due on his muscle injury.

quote.text: It’s a muscle injury and we do [a scan] in some days again, but we are going to miss him, for sure, for four or five weeks.

teamNews.line: Brian Brobbey's absence is expected to be brief, though the club will not take risks with him.

quote.text: It’s going to be short-term [for Brobbey, as well].

teamNews.line: Kaine Kesler-Hayden is back training with the group after a longer spell out.

quote.text: Aurele is working away. It’s a 2-3 month injury, so we’re working through that.
